What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

This is a self-hosted digital commerce system built on open infrastructure. It uses Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. When a buyer sends payment, NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain and triggers a webhook. Cloudflare Workers automates file delivery. The buyer gets the beat instantly. You get paid in crypto—USDT, BTC, or any of 300+ currencies. The stack operates without intermediaries. No platform fees. No geographic restrictions. Full data ownership. This is not a temporary fix. It is a permanent architecture designed to outlast payment blockades and platform lockdowns.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack begins with Cloudflare Pages hosting your storefront. Cloudflare Workers handles backend logic, including order processing and file delivery. Supabase stores order data securely. NOWPayments integrates as the payment processor, converting USD prices to crypto at transaction time. When a payment confirms on-chain, NOWPayments fires a webhook to Cloudflare Workers. The script verifies the payment, retrieves the beat file from Cloudflare R2, and sends a secure download link to the buyer. The entire process is automated, instantaneous, and runs without human intervention. You configure the system once. It operates indefinitely. No server management required. No ongoing costs beyond the 0.5% NOWPayments fee.

Your Deployment Checklist

Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
